text:
Yara: hey all, Yara here. starting oncall next week and hitting a few setup snags. who should I DM for SSO <-> PagerDuty mapping?
Ken: welcome! ping #eng-identity for mapping. If your PD shows no services, it's usually missing team tags on the SSO profile.
Luca: i can also check tags if you post your SSO username here. common tags: 'sre-core', 'payments', 'ingest'.
Yara: thanks — posted SSO user: yara@redwood. PD shows only 'Company-wide' with no service list.
pager-bot: reminder: complete PD device registration (https://pd.redwood/setup) and verify MFA. Agents without services cannot receive service-specific pages.
Ava: while that gets sorted, sign up for a shadow slot for the staging drill. we run a simulated failover every Wed 18:00. DM me if you want a private pairing.
Yara: booked the Wed slot. question: who approves temporary access to secure runbooks for key rotation during shadowing?
Ken: Ops lead can grant temporary read access for staging-only via the access form; for production-level secure-runbooks you need manager sign-off and a vault approval.
Luca: Ops can grant a 48h preview token for shadowing; send a request to InfraTeam with reason 'oncall-shadow'.
Yara: got it. another one: there's a timezone mismatch in the rota showing me 12 hours off. i've set SSO to America/Los_Angeles.
InfraTeam: rota imports sometimes use the account locale. We've queued a rota_sync for yara@redwood. Expect fix within 10 minutes. If not, reply here and we'll force-refresh.
Yara: sync complete, rota now shows correct slot. thanks!
Ava: onboarding tip: skim the 'first-24hr' runbook, do one staging drill, and read the escalation flow (page -> owner -> oncall-lead -> manager). early escalation is preferred.
Yara: escalation question: if the pager is noisy during a deploy, can i suppress alerts temporarily? what's required?
Ken: you can set a suppression only with a maintenance ticket. It needs release-manager approval and must include an explicit expiry and list of suppressed alerts. Never mute ad-hoc.
Luca: add the maintenance ticket link to the suppression so it's auditable.
Yara: if the PD chain doesn't ACK, what's manual escalation?
Ava: call the oncall-lead emergency number (in pinned messages), escalate in the emergency call tree, and create a war-room channel. For sev1, if unacked > 10min, page exec-oncall.
Yara: runbook edits during incidents — allowed?
Ken: small clarifying edits ok (typos, small steps) but create a docs PR after the incident. For substantive changes, open a PR and tag the runbook owner; don't restructure during a live page.
Ava: also add a one-line note in the alert timeline describing the change so the next responder isn't surprised.
Yara: last: how to hand off across timezones? do we include local times?
Luca: yes, include both local and UTC times in /handoff message and list any running maintenance or followups that require business-hour owners. Example format in pinned messages.
Yara: perfect. i'll finish PD setup, DM Ken my SSO username if mapping fails, and join the Wed staging drill. thanks everyone!
InfraTeam: rota_sync completed and temporary runbook preview granted for Yara until +48h. Check your inbox for links.
pager-bot: scheduled: staging-drill Wed 18:00 (invite sent).
Ava: welcome aboard again 389. ping any of us if you want extra pairing before your first live page.
Yara: will do, appreciate the help :)
